findings.failure: Declared-root submission is enforced only inside evaluate_roots. The public open_project + ProjectExecution::rule route runs project rules with no ProjectTask declaration, no host guard and no batch cohort, and one session may run any number of rules. Concrete: open a session from rule 0's scope/frontiers, then call session.rule(RuleIndex(1)); validate_consumer_sources (frontiers/types.rs:80-99) returns Ok when frontier sources are empty, so rule 1 runs undeclared and unguarded. No production caller uses this route (only tests).
findings.required_enforcement: Remove or seal the public open_project/ProjectExecution route (sessions constructible only inside ProjectRootExecution::evaluate), add a compile_fail control for the removed route and a runtime control where a declared-0/named-1 in-range mismatch is refused.

findings.failure: The route census is a self-derived string scan over `impl <Trait> for` lines against a hard-coded SUBMISSION_TRAITS list. It counts trait impls, not methods: ExecutionRequest is satisfied by file_route (open_file) alone, so open_project, observations and prepare_frontiers have no control. ProjectExecution and ObservationExecution are outside the list. A new trait, a multi-line impl header or a new method on an existing trait escapes. The census is not the authoritative inventory.
findings.required_enforcement: Make the inventory compiler-derived: seal the submission traits, or have an exhaustive enum of entry methods matched in the test so adding a method breaks compilation. Add per-method controls including open_project.

findings.failure: The 'extra root' control uses only the out-of-range rule 3 of 3, which rule_metadata refuses for any implementation. An in-range undeclared root (declared 0, named 1) is never tested and would be accepted (see finding 1). 'Omitted root gets no outcome' cannot fail for any implementation that does not invent outcomes. Neither control rejects a weaker implementation.
findings.required_enforcement: Add in-range mismatch and duplicate-root controls that fail against the current validate_consumer_sources shortcut, or state and type the project-route completeness rule. File-route ShapeMismatch is a real control. The project route has no equivalent.

findings.failure: The ProjectExecution compile_fail,E0599 doctest imports only FileExecution and calls project.emit_rows(). Adding emit_rows to the ProjectExecution trait still yields E0599 (trait not in scope), so the doctest keeps passing. The route audit claim that it 'fails the build if emit_rows is added to a project session' is false for the most likely change.
findings.required_enforcement: Import ProjectExecution (and the glob of interface traits) in the doctest, and pair it with a passing authorized example. Alternatively, enforce through a TM rule on the trait's method set.

findings.failure: TM ran on a self-selected file list that covers 31 of 128 files under application/file_dag/program/** and 4 of 11 invocation files. 69 production files were never checked, including program.rs, facade_runtime/{service,types,file_execution}.rs, protocol/types.rs, preparation/*, file_execution/{rule,walk,frontier,emission}/service.rs and project_execution/{deliver,sources}/service.rs (most of them new in this diff).
